title: bepirovirsen PDUFA, treatment of adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB)
description: The FDA has assigned 26 October 2026 as the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal date.

title: Ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) BLA filing decision, Huntington's disease
description: uniQure submitted the BLA for the accelerated approval of ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's disease on September 2, 2026 and requested priority review: "If granted, priority review would shorten the FDA review cycle to six months following the FDA's 60-day BLA filing review period." The filing decision is due within 60 days of submission, on or before 2026-11-01; the FDA sets an action date only once it files the BLA. Dated by the submission and the 60-day period, not by an FDA letter (8-K 0001104659-26-104463).

title: Deramiocel PDUFA, Duchenne muscular dystrophy
description: On August 24, 2026, Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") has extended the Prescription Drug User Fee Act ("PDUFA") target action date for its Biologics License Application ("BLA") for Deramiocel, an investigational cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy ("DMD"), from August 22, 2026 to November 22, 2026.

title: Empasiprubart EMPASSION topline, multifocal motor neuropathy
description: argenx expects topline results from the registrational EMPASSION study (MMN) in the fourth quarter of 2026 (H1 2026 report on 6-K 0001697862-26-000033, filed 2026-07-23, and its release). EMPASSION is NCT06742190: 154 adults with MMN randomised to empasiprubart or IVIg, double-blind and double-dummy, primary endpoint the change in the 25-item MMN-RODS centile score at week 24. The registry dates its primary completion to 2026-09, which has passed, so no feed dates the readout; it is dated to the end of the quarter.

title: CagriSema decision, obesity
description: Novo submitted CagriSema (NN9838) for obesity in the US in 2025 (20-F 0000353278-26-000012: "Cagrisema (NN9838)/ Obesity Regulatory submission in 2025") and lists the US decision among its Q4 2026 regulatory milestones (H1 2026 report, 6-K 0000353278-26-000023, page 21, "Anticipated key R&D milestones in 2026"). No 6-K to 6 October 2026 reports the decision. Dated to the end of that quarter; the FDA date itself is not published. The REDEFINE 4 miss of 23 February 2026 was non-inferiority against tirzepatide, not an efficacy failure, and Novo kept the decision on its Q4 list after it.

title: zeleciment rostudirsen (z-rostudirsen, also known as DYNE-251) PDUFA, Duchenne muscular dystrophy ("DMD") amenable to exon 51 skipping
description: The FDA has granted the BLA Priority Review and assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act target action date of January 21, 2027.

title: Jemperli PDUFA, dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer
description: Sized, not counted. 46,950 rectal cancers are diagnosed in the US each year (American Cancer Society, Cancer Facts & Figures 2025); about 64.5% present at stage II or III and 5% to 10% of rectal adenocarcinomas are mismatch repair deficient, so the label would reach roughly 2,270 patients a year. At the $80,337 a beneficiary Jemperli cost Medicare on Part B in 2024 and 80% uptake, which is what an organ-sparing option earns, that is $146mm in the US and about GBP 144m worldwide on Jemperli's 75% US split. It is not in the product's ceiling of GBP 1,440m, which covers endometrial cancer only, because it is not approved: the FDA accepted the application under priority review with breakthrough designation, on 49 of 49 rectal patients reaching a clinical complete response.

title: zanzalintinib PDUFA, treatment of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer
description: The updated Prescription Drug User Fee Act action date is March 3, 2027.

title: lonvoguran ziclumeran ("lonvo-z") PDUFA, hereditary angioedema
description: Also on September 8, 2026, the Company announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") has accepted the Biologics License Application ("BLA") for lonvoguran ziclumeran ("lonvo-z") and granted the BLA Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act ("PDUFA") target action date of March 10, 2027.

title: Zeleciment basivarsen (DYNE-101) ACHIEVE registrational expansion cohort topline, myotonic dystrophy type 1
description: Dyne continues to expect topline data in Q1 2027 from the ACHIEVE registrational expansion cohort (REC), with a primary endpoint of change from baseline in vHOT at 6 months, intended to support a potential submission for U.S. Accelerated Approval in Q3 2027. The cohort of 71 is fully enrolled within ACHIEVE (NCT05481879), which the registry dates to its whole study's primary completion in 2029-07, so no feed dates this readout; it is dated to the end of the quarter.

title: AXS-12 PDUFA, treatment of cataplexy in narcolepsy
description: The FDA has set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of May 1, 2027.

title: Denecimig decision, hemophilia A
description: The FDA has set no date. The BLA was submitted in September 2025 with a decision expected in the third quarter of 2026; the FDA extended its review for remediation at a manufacturing site and "has not communicated a new timeline", with no deficiencies found in the clinical efficacy or safety data. Novo aims to launch in the US in the first half of 2027 pending the decision, so the row is dated to the end of that half (Novo Nordisk 6-K of 2026-10-02, 0001171843-26-006374).

title: Amondys 45 PDUFA, Duchenne muscular dystrophy amenable to exon 45 skipping
description: The FDA has set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of February 28, 2027 for Sarepta's sNDAs to convert AMONDYS 45 and VYONDYS 53 from accelerated to traditional approval (Sarepta's release of 2026-06-30, as RTTNews and BioPharm International quote it the same day). The 10-Q for the June quarter (0001193125-26-335003) confirms the sNDAs were submitted in April 2026 and accepted for filing in June 2026 but gives no date. They rest on ESSENCE (NCT02500381), which missed its primary endpoint at P=0.309 (8-K 0001193125-25-262591). The failed leg on Amondys 45 (casimersen) is withdrawal of the accelerated approval; a refusal that leaves it in place is worth the converted case.

title: Vyondys 53 PDUFA, Duchenne muscular dystrophy amenable to exon 53 skipping
description: The FDA has set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of February 28, 2027 for Sarepta's sNDAs to convert AMONDYS 45 and VYONDYS 53 from accelerated to traditional approval (Sarepta's release of 2026-06-30, as RTTNews and BioPharm International quote it the same day). title: ivonescimab PDUFA, epidermal growth factor receptor-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer post-tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy
description: HARMONi (NCT06396065), ivonescimab with chemotherapy after a third-generation EGFR TKI. Summit's Q2 2026 10-Q (0001599298-26-000068): 'Summit announced in January 2026 that the FDA accepted for filing the BLA, seeking approval for ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy for this proposed indication. The FDA provided a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal action date of November 14, 2026. The FDA noted that a statistically significant OS benefit is necessary to support marketing authorization in this setting, and the PFS results from this study may not be sufficient to support marketing authorization.' One decision, read from two filings (the January 2026 8-K and the September AstraZeneca 8-K); this row is its record.

title: Ivonescimab HARMONi-3 squamous cohort primary PFS analysis, first-line squamous NSCLC
description: HARMONi-3 (NCT05899608), ivonescimab with chemotherapy against pembrolizumab with chemotherapy, squamous cohort of about 600 patients, enrolment completed in Q1 2026. Q2 2026 10-Q (0001599298-26-000068): 'The number of PFS events needed in the squamous cohort for the primary analysis is expected to be reached in the second half of 2026, and a planned early interim analysis for OS is expected to take place in conjunction with the primary PFS analysis.' The date is the end of the half in which the events are guided; the topline follows them.

title: Ivonescimab HARMONi-3 non-squamous cohort primary PFS analysis, first-line non-squamous NSCLC
description: HARMONi-3 (NCT05899608), non-squamous cohort of about 1,000 patients, enrolment completed in Q2 2026. Q2 2026 10-Q (0001599298-26-000068): 'For this cohort, the number of events needed to conduct the PFS analysis is expected to be reached in the first half of 2027.' The date is the end of that half; the topline follows the events.

title: Ivonescimab HARMONi-3 interim overall survival analysis, first-line NSCLC
description: HARMONi-3 (NCT05899608), ivonescimab with chemotherapy against pembrolizumab with chemotherapy, with PFS and OS as primary endpoints in each cohort. Q2 2026 10-Q (0001599298-26-000068), after the squamous cohort's guidance: 'An interim analysis for overall survival independent of PFS is planned for the first half of 2027.' The filing does not say which cohort it reads, so the title names the study. Dated to the end of that half. The FDA's stated position on HARMONi, that a statistically significant OS benefit is necessary in that setting (same 10-Q), is why an OS read matters here.
